title: Mouse holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='balloon' cx='40%' cy='35%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff8fa8'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e0344f'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- balloon string -->
  <path d='M66 40 Q62 52 60 62' stroke='#f2e6a0' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='67' cy='26' rx='13' ry='15' fill='url(#balloon)'/>
  <path d='M64 40 L70 40 L67 44 Z' fill='#b02040'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='21' rx='3.5' ry='5' fill='#ffd0da' opacity='0.85'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M30 74 Q22 78 26 84 Q31 82 30 74' fill='#c58a5a'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='47' cy='68' rx='19' ry='15' fill='#b0a8b8'/>
  <ellipse cx='47' cy='72' rx='13' ry='9' fill='#d8d2dc'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='83' rx='6' ry='3.5' fill='#e8a0a8'/>
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='83' rx='6' ry='3.5' fill='#e8a0a8'/>
  <!-- arm holding string -->
  <path d='M60 62 Q63 56 59 50' stroke='#b0a8b8' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='49' r='3.5' fill='#e8a0a8'/>
  <!-- other arm -->
  <path d='M35 64 Q30 62 28 66' stroke='#b0a8b8' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='27' cy='67' r='3.5' fill='#e8a0a8'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='31' cy='44' r='9' fill='#9a92a4'/>
  <circle cx='31' cy='44' r='5' fill='#e8a0a8'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='44' r='9' fill='#9a92a4'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='44' r='5' fill='#e8a0a8'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='54' rx='17' ry='15' fill='#b0a8b8'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='60' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#d8d2dc'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <circle cx='46' cy='57' r='2.6' fill='#f0a0b0'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='39' cy='50' r='2.8' fill='#2a2440'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='50' r='2.8' fill='#2a2440'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='49' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='49' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <path d='M34 59 L26 57 M34 62 L26 63 M58 59 L66 57 M58 62 L66 63' stroke='#e8dfe8' stroke-width='1' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
